Input image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. This is fictional scenery inspired by news, not a documentary image of an actual site. MISSION 1: Taiwan offshore wind development and the need for actual grid connection. A rugged crescent island with a compact working fishing village and port on its sheltered inner shore. Three elegant offshore turbines in the open water on the right, a modest coastal electrical substation near the village and an empty service work pad. A coherent coastal road loops around village houses and leads to substation and pier; visible service harbor with cable-laying vessel. A subtle cable landing at the water edge, not a giant exposed underwater yellow cable. Preserve natural rocky habitat separated from the harbor; a broad uncluttered ocean corridor between wind farm and port clearly communicates energy delivery. Pale stone village, muted terracotta roofs, teal-blue water. Layout: land occupies left half and center, wind farm on right, port along lower middle coast. Clear gentle daylight.
